primary.name: RAISE THE STANDARD
primary.objective: After choosing this card, plant your standard on a square at least 3 squares from your deployment zone and from every objective, outside the enemy deployment zone. At the end of each Battle Round, score 1 VP if a friendly unit is within 1 square of the standard and no enemy unit is, or 2 VP if the standard stands in the enemy half. Score 1 VP more if you also held it at the end of the previous Battle Round. If an enemy unit is within 1 square of it and no friendly unit is at the end of a Battle Round, it is torn down for good.
